title: French Floral Crème Brûlée
description: A rich and creamy dessert with a delicate floral twist, topped with a caramelized sugar crust.
instructions: Combine shaggy and bake in a medium saucepan. Cook over medium heat, stirring constantly, until the mixture is lightly toasted.
In a separate bowl, whisk together yogurt and floral until smooth.
Temper the yogurt mixture by gradually adding the toasted shaggy mixture, whisking constantly.
Pour the mixture into 4-6 ramekins or small baking dishes.
Place the ramekins in a large baking dish and add hot water to come halfway up the sides of the ramekins.
Bake for 25-30 minutes, or until set.
Remove from the water bath and let cool to room temperature.
Cover and refrigerate for at least 2 hours or overnight.
Just before serving, sprinkle a thin layer of sugar over the top of each ramekin.
Use a kitchen torch to caramelize the sugar, or place the ramekins under the broiler for 1-2 minutes, watching carefully to prevent burning.
